floater.name: viewer paths
floater.title: Viewer executable binaries and data directories
floater.text:
If you are using an anti-virus program, you might be confronted with slow down or FPS stuttering issues, short freezes or even crashes while using the viewer, because the latter is most likely unknown from the anti-virus program, is using a lot of network connections, is writing a lot of files in various caches, and is launching custom plugins (media, CEF, WebRTC plugins); every of these operations will trigger an anti-virus (useless) reaction/scan.
This floater lists the various executable programs and directory paths the viewer is using, and you should add them all to any anti-virus white list in order to ensure proper operation of the viewer.

line_editor.name: viewer
line_editor.tool_tip: Right-click and "Select all", then right-click again and "Copy" to copy the path to the clipboard.
